cronjobs.name: ALYGN: Municipal Outreach Daily
cronjobs.description: Daily municipal outreach for Costa Rica cantons with test mode

payload.message:
Execute Municipal Outreach Pipeline for Costa Rica:

STEP 1: Discovery
- Run: cd $HOME/.openclaw/workspace && node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/discovery/muni-discovery.js
- Loads 82 cantones from costa-rica-real-municipalities.json

STEP 2: Research
- Run: node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/research/muni-research.js
- Finds mayor names/emails from pre-verified data
- Output: /tmp/muni-researched.json

STEP 3: Personalization
- Run: node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/personalization/muni-personalizer.js --input=/tmp/muni-researched.json
- Generates Spanish emails using Grok
- Replaces ALL placeholders: {mayor_name}, {municipality}, {personalized_pain_point}, etc.
- Output: /tmp/muni-personalized.json

STEP 4: Send (Test Mode - TEST ONLY)
- Run: node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/sending/email-sender-smtp-v2.js --input=/tmp/muni-personalized.json --test-email=contact@andler.dev --approved --limit=5
- Sends to contact@andler.dev (test redirect)
- Requires --approved flag for safety

TEMPLATE PARAMETERS:
- recipientName: municipality.contacts.mayor_name (e.g., 'Luis Diego Miranda')
- municipality: municipality.name (e.g., 'San José')
- painPoints: municipality.pain_points.join(', ') (e.g., 'budget shortages, poor planning, drug trafficking')
- subject: Generated by personalizer (e.g., 'Alianza Estratégica para la Salvaguarda Institucional - San José')
- bodyHtml: Full personalized body (ALL placeholders replaced with regex /g flag)
- bodyText: Auto-generated from HTML via htmlToText()
- variant: 'governance' | 'institutional' (auto-selected based on municipality characteristics)
- footer: Optional custom footer (uses template default if not provided)
- useCid: false (uses base64 PNG logo)

REPORTING:
- Post summary to Discord #annotations (1466532145257255004)
- Include: sent count, municipality names, message IDs, any errors
- Attach /tmp/muni-sent.json for full details

cronjobs.name: ALYGN: VC Outreach (Lobster)
cronjobs.description: Daily VC outreach with two-filter system ensuring drafts connect to sends

payload.message:
Execute Alygn VC outreach with two-filter system ensuring drafts connect to sends.

WORKFLOW:
1. CHECK: Verify 100 VCs in Notion with Draft Status
2. PERSONALIZE: Run personalization for approved VCs
   - Generate personalized drafts with partner names
   - Set Draft Status = 'Drafted' in Notion
3. REVIEW: Check Discord #annotations for approval
   - Approved VCs: Draft Status = 'Approved'
   - Rejected VCs: Draft Status = 'Rejected'
4. SEND: Execute send ONLY with both filters:
   - Filter 1: --draft-status=Approved
   - Filter 2: --email-send-to=approved_entity_ids
   - Example: node send-approved-emails.js --draft-status=Approved --email-send-to=id1,id2
5. VERIFY: Confirm sends recorded in SentEmailTracker
   - Check Notion: Draft Status updated to 'Sent'
   - Check for bounce notifications
   - Report summary to Discord

CRITICAL:
- NEVER send without --email-send-to (random selection)
- ALWAYS use both filters together
- VERIFY entity IDs match between personalize and send

Use absolute paths with $HOME/.openclaw/workspace

both_systems.body: Main content (Muni: from personalizer, VC: optional)
